title: San Francisco Chinatown Walking Tour With A Guide
includes: Help from our team to book the tickets for the desired visits.
In-person: English, Spanish, French, Italian speaking Guide
Private or Small group tour available
Entry to monuments and museums (not included)
Transportations (The cost of using public transport during the tour is at your own expense) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note: A minimum of 2 participants is required for the group option.
policies: It's a city tour and not a tour inside the monuments.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the vibrant culture of San Francisco's Chinatown on an immersive walking tour. With a knowledgeable guide, navigate through bustling streets adorned with colorful Chinese decorations and soak in the lively atmosphere. Discover hidden gems alongside popular spots, gaining insights into the neighborhood's rich history and evolving present. Visit an herbal pharmacy, where you'll learn about traditional Chinese medicine and its enduring significance. Wander through bustling food markets, exploring exotic produce and specialty goods unique to the area. The tour culminates with a visit to a local fortune cookie factory, where you can sample freshly made cookies and witness their crafting process. Throughout the journey, your guide's stories and insights paint a vivid picture of Chinatown's cultural heritage, creating a memorable and enlightening experience.
